question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Prudent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"prudent"** means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (सावधान)

 
 
• **Example: **It is **prudent** to save money for emergencies.
 
 
 
• **"Judicious" **refers to having, showing, or done with good judgment or sense. (विवेकपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **He made a **judicious **decision to invest in education.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Judicious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Precious **(कीमती): Of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly.

 
 
• **Example:** Time is precious, so use it wisely.
 
 
 
• **Diffident **(संकोची): Modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence.
 
 
• **Example: **She was diffident when speaking in public.
 
 
 
• **Doubtful** (संदिग्ध): Feeling uncertain about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was doubtful about the outcome of the test.
